data.name: Draw It, Forget It
data.detailed_description:
DRAW FAST. FORGET FASTER.

A series of prompts appears, one after another. You have only a few seconds to sketch each one, with no time to polish your work or start over.

After the drawing rush, quick distraction challenges push the prompts out of your memory. Then your sketches return. Can you still work out what each one was supposed to be?

No drawing skill is required. The less recognizable the sketch, the funnier the reveal may become.

OUTSMART YOUR OWN DRAWINGS

In solo mode, each round takes you through rapid sketching, memory distractions, guessing, and a final reveal.

Choose a difficulty preset or customize the drawing time and number of distraction challenges. Enable confusing prompt groups to receive several similarly shaped subjects in a row and make the guessing phase even harder.

After each round, review your sketches and keep your favorite results in the local History Gallery.

TWO LAN PARTY MODES

Everyone Draws This

Each player submits a prompt, and the room votes to choose one. Everyone draws the winning prompt before voting for the most accurate and most abstract creations.

Pass It, Twist It

Each player begins with a different prompt. Drawings are passed between players, who must observe, remember, and redraw what they saw. At the end, everyone guesses the original prompt before the complete chain is revealed.

LAN multiplayer supports 2 to 6 players. Each player needs a PC connected to the same local network.

KEY FEATURES

  • Rapid, time-limited drawing rounds

  • Memory-scrambling distraction challenges

  • Difficulty presets and customizable game settings

  • Optional groups of confusing, similarly shaped prompts

  • Solo play and two LAN multiplayer modes

  • Comedic reveals and complete round recaps

  • A local History Gallery for saved sketches

  • No artistic ability required

REMOTE ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Remote online multiplayer is currently in development and is planned for the full release. The current playable version focuses on solo play and LAN multiplayer.

data.short_description: Draw prompts in seconds, clear your memory with quick distractions, then decipher your own wonderfully confusing sketches. Play solo or join friends over LAN for voting, shared drawing challenges, and hilarious chains of drawings that drift farther from the original idea.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible dedicated or integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
